### Insights - Since we have enough data, i have decided to remove the nulls 
```{python}
data=data.dropna()
```

## Sorting Companies by Valuation
```{python}
data=data.sort_values(by="Year Founded", ascending=True)
data.head(10)
```
## Analyzing Company Founding Trends by Year.
```{python}
data["Year Founded"].value_counts()
#data.groupby("Year Founded")["Year Founded"].count()
```
## Ploting a histogram of the Year Founded feature.
```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

plt.figure(figsize=(15,6))
sns.histplot(data["Year Founded"], color="Pink", kde=True)
plt.title("Distribution of Companies by Year Founded")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
## Converting the Date Joined Column to Datetime Format
```{python}
data["Date Joined"]=pd.to_datetime(data["Date Joined"])
data.info()
```
## Extracting the Month Companies Achieved Unicorn Status
```{python}
data["Month Joined"]=data["Date Joined"].dt.month
data.head(10)
```
## Calculating the Time Taken for Companies to Achieve Unicorn Status
```{python}
data["Years To Join"]=data["Date Joined"].dt.year - data["Year Founded"]
data.head(10)
```
## Analyzing the Distribution of Unicorn Companies by Year
```{python}
data["Date Joined"].dt.year.value_counts()
```
## Filtering Companies Based on Unicorn Status Year
```{python}
data_2021=data[data["Date Joined"].dt.year==2021]
data_2021.head(10)
```
```{python}
data_2021.describe()
```
## Observing Unicorn Company Trends Over Time
```{python}
data_2021_monthly_trend=data_2021.groupby("Month Joined")['Company'].count()
```
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(data_2021_monthly_trend)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
## Comparing Average Unicorn Company Valuations Across Time Intervals
```{python}
data_2022=data[data["Date Joined"].dt.year==2022]
data_2022.describe()
```
```{python}
combined_2021_2022=pd.concat([data_2021,data_2022])
combined_2021_2022.head(20)
```
```{python}
combined_2021_2022.describe()
```
```{python}
combined_2021_2022["Valuation"]=combined_2021_2022["Valuation"].str.replace("$","")
combined_2021_2022["Valuation"]=combined_2021_2022["Valuation"].str.replace("B","")
```
```{python}
combined_2021_2022["Valuation"]=combined_2021_2022["Valuation"].astype(float)
combined_2021_2022.head()
```
```{python}
monthly_avg_2021_2022=combined_2021_2022.groupby("Month Joined")["Valuation"].mean()
```
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(monthly_avg_2021_2022)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
## Visualizing the Time Taken for Companies to Achieve Unicorn Status (Monthly)
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))
sns.boxplot(x="Month Joined", y="Years To Join", data=data)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
## Visualizing the Average Time Taken for Companies to Achieve Unicorn Status
```{python}
avg_year=data.groupby("Year Founded")["Years To Join"].mean()
```
```{python}
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(avg_year)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
```
## Visualizing the Number of Companies Achieving Unicorn Status Per Month
```{python}
monthly_trend = data_2021.groupby("Month Joined")["Company"].count()
```
```{python}
# Set figure size
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))

# Create bar plot
sns.barplot(
    x=monthly_trend.index,
    y=monthly_trend.values
)

# Set x-axis label
plt.xlabel("Month Joined")

# Set y-axis label
plt.ylabel("Number of Companies")

# Set title
plt.title("Number of Companies That Achieved Unicorn Status Per Month in 2021")

# Rotate x-axis labels
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Display plot
plt.show()
```
## Visualizing Average Unicorn Company Valuation Across Quarters
```{python}
# Extract year from Date Joined
combined_2021_2022["Year Joined"] = combined_2021_2022["Date Joined"].dt.year

# Extract quarter from Date Joined
combined_2021_2022["Quarter Joined"] = combined_2021_2022["Date Joined"].dt.quarter
```
```{python}
# Set figure size
plt.figure(figsize=(12,6))

# Create grouped bar plot
sns.barplot(
    x="Quarter Joined",
    y="Valuation",
    hue="Year Joined",
    data=combined_2021_2022
)

# Set x-axis label
plt.xlabel("Quarter Joined")

# Set y-axis label
plt.ylabel("Average Valuation")

# Set title
plt.title("Average Unicorn Company Valuation Across Quarters")

# Display plot
plt.show()
```
